name: Flooded Greater Steam · Fire ×2
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 4.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 21 s and leaves a puddle
• Knockback
• Heat: sets on fire for 10.8 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Blindness for 3.75 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
